items.title: GPT-Live 1.1 now available on AI Gateway
items.summary: is now available on AI Gateway.GPT-Live 1.1 from OpenAIGPT-Live 1.1 is a full-duplex voice model, so it listens while it speaks and a caller can pause, interrupt, or add detail mid-reply. Compared with the previous GPT-Live model, it transcribes speech more accurately and keeps a more consistent accent and voice across languages. It uses the same Live endpoint and client delegation, so an existing GPT-Live integration only needs the new model ID.Run  by itself:openai/gpt-live-1.1Turn on client delegation, and use the session instructions to tell GPT-Live 1.1 when to ask for help. It asks by sending delegation-created. Answer with any text model on AI Gateway and return the result on the commentary channel for GPT-Live to speak. This example uses openai/gpt-6.2-sol and builds on the session above:Your application controls delegated work and its permissions, confirmations, and cancellation. Delegated model requests are billed separately through AI Gateway, and voice-session usage continues while they run.
